title: Sofacy_Fysbis_Investigation_b65
description: Investigate a Sofacy Fysbis malware compromise in a target network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target network has been compromised by the Sofacy group using their Fysbis malware. Your task is to investigate the compromise, identify the malicious activity, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the system and access other hosts as needed. Enter `start` to progress to the training levels.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the system and access other hosts as needed. Enter `start` to progress to the training levels.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Network Activity
levels.content: While monitoring network traffic, you noticed unusual outbound connections from the target host. Investigate this activity to identify the source of the connections.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or unfamiliar services. The suspicious service is `systemkernelservicedefender.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Review the systemd services for any anomalies or unfamiliar entries.

levels.title: Analyze Suspicious Service
levels.content: You've identified a suspicious service. Now, analyze it to understand its behavior and determine if it's related to the Fysbis malware.
levels.solution: Examine the service unit file and the script it executes. The service connects to port 80 on the c2-server host with the message 'systemkernelservicedefender'. The final flag is `80`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Inspect the service unit file and any associated scripts for suspicious behavior.

levels.title: Investigate Lateral Movement
levels.content: Check if the attacker has attempted to move laterally from the target host to other hosts in the network.
levels.solution: Look for any scripts or services that transfer files or execute commands on remote hosts. The `payload-transfer.sh` script and the `payload-transfer.service` transfer files to the next-target host.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Search for scripts or services that might facilitate lateral movement.
